## Change

Describe the problem, resulting behavior, and relevant requirement.

## Validation

Commands run and observed results. For experiments, include config, dataset hash,
split ID, source commit, selection score, and output location.

## Scientific review

- [ ] Feature availability matches the declared prediction point.
- [ ] Preprocessing is fit inside training folds; final test data was not used for selection.
- [ ] Comparison uses the agreed split, metric, and budget.
- [ ] No raw data, credentials, or generated model binaries are included.
